messages:
camila: Dropping a quick design check — added a burn-rate slider to the SLO threshold editor and a live preview for affected channels. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/burn-rate-slider
matt: looked — nice! one quick thing: when the slider is >1.0 the preview should highlight 'fast burn' channels in orange, otherwise green. tiny: add a tooltip for exact multiplier (e.g. '2.0x burn')
jon: Copy nit: current label 'Burn rate' confused a PM I showed it to — can we use 'Rate multiplier' or 'Multiplier (burn rate)' to make it clearer for non-SREs?
camila: Good call. 'Multiplier (burn rate)' might work. Also thinking about default value: keeping it at 1.0 but show a subtle hint under the slider: "Typical: 1.0 — higher values trigger earlier paging" — thoughts?
liz: +1 on hint. Accessibility: keyboard users need to be able to nudge by 0.1 with arrow keys and have the same aria-live preview. Right now the preview updates but SR doesn't announce which channels will page.
aria-bot: Accessibility check: ensure slider has role="slider", aria-valuemin="0.1" aria-valuemax="5.0" aria-valuenow updated on change, and aria-describedby points to the preview summary.
matt: For preview copy, instead of 'Pages: 3 channels', use 'Will notify: PagerDuty (3), Email (1)' — short list so screenreaders can parse concise channel names.
jon: UX flow question: if a channel is suppressed (quiet window) should preview still list it with a muted icon and 'suppressed'? I think yes, but visually de-emphasize.
camila: Yes — show it in the preview with an opacity and a small muted badge + tooltip 'suppressed by quiet window'. Also allow click-through to open that channel's quiet window settings.
liz: Keyboard path: make sure suppressed channel is focusable and the tooltip appears on focus, not just hover.
camila: Interaction polish: when user drags slider fast we should throttle preview updates (150ms) to avoid jank. Also show a small 'preview is approximate' microcopy if user is at high multiplier due to potential batching differences.
matt: Copy suggestion: microcopy = "Preview shows expected notifications; exact routing may vary under high load." Shorten if needed.
jon: Visual: add a small inline legend: orange = will escalate, gray = suppressed, blue = notify but non-urgent. Keeps preview readable.
aria-bot: Contrast check: orange (#FF8C42) on white passes AA for large text but fails for small labels. Consider darker orange or bold label for small text.
liz: Also ensure keyboard focus ring is 3px and uses theme contrast — some of our dark themes had subtle rings that get lost.
camila: I'll update figma with: label change, tooltip text, keyboard increments, aria attributes, legend, suppressed channel affordance, and throttled preview. Ping if anyone wants to pair on the wording.
matt: Quick QA ask: can we add a unit test for slider aria updates and a visual regression for the suppressed state? I'll add tickets.
jon: Final copy try: 'Multiplier (burn rate) — how fast the SLO budget is consumed; higher values trigger earlier notifications.' Maybe too long.
camila: Maybe: 'Multiplier (burn rate) — controls how aggressively we notify for SLO burn.' Short and explicit.
liz: That works for UI label + we can expand in the tooltip for clarity.
camila: cool — thanks team. I'll sketch the keyboard flow and post new frames in ~2 hours. :sparkles:
